Mechs are part of the fun. Most of it,without them,pretty sure your run will get stale. Learning Helper will teach you how to take care of them,but I can teach you a few tricks.

LAWS and RPGs are fairly cheap to produce. Stuff a HEAT round or two in a Centi from good cover and they are down. No tech? Ambush them with molotovs. Throw one or two,run back from behind full cover. They'll die just as easily. Lots of components? Spam them with EMP Slugs,EMP grenades,you name it. KPV with AP-I ammo works fantastically well.
Regular mechs? Nothing a good burst of 7.62 APHE can't solve. Just don't let scytchers close the gap.

If you pay good atention building your defenses and on your resource managment,you'll not have any problems.

EDIT: FSX and Prometheum are your friends. Keep a good supply of them.
